newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to begin trading five new options Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to begin trading five new options Wednesday.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said it will list options on five new options starting Wednesday, October 9.
Alpha Industries, American Homepatient Inc,, Astra AB, Bindley Western Industries and Oakwood Homes Corp debut at the PHLX on Wednesday.

Options on Alpha Industries and American Homepatient will have expiration months of November, December, February and May. The opening strike prices for Alpha Industries will be 5, 7-1/2, and 10 and TFM Investment group will be the specialist. Opening strike prices for American Homepatient will be 22-1/2, 25 and 30.
Astra AB options will open with strike prices of 40, 45 and 50, and expiration months of November, December, January and April. Gateway Partneers will be the specialist.

Options on Bindley Western Industries and Oakwood Home Corp. will trade with expiration months of November, December, March and June. Bindley's specialist will be TFM Investment Group, and opening strike prices will be 15, 17-1/2 and 20. Opening strike prices for Oakwood Homes Corp are 25, 30 and 35, and Group One LTD will be the speicalist.
